scope: Workspace-first conversations, application preset binding, reusable production environments and versioned run/configuration/participation/artifact evidence.

checks.check: Every host package with Go race detector
checks.note: Two earlier attempts exposed timing assumptions in Docker fixtures. The cancellation fixture now waits for the media build to start. The duplicate submission fixture keeps the original preparation active until submission. Both corrected cases passed three targeted race rounds. All app tests then ran in four disjoint shards; other host packages ran separately. atexit_sleep_ms=0 avoids artificial exit waits for the many subprocess fixtures.

limitations: Only Codex is a daily execution adapter; Kun is used for maintenance. No Claude Code, Pi, cross-engine tool translation, or end-user handoff was implemented.
Persisted configuration revisions are platform declarations and live source references, not complete captured native configurations.
New origin fields are evidence-based; legacy history can lack configuration or native execution records. Optional artifact scans may be unavailable for large folders.

No real model/provider, live Docker build or target-server verification. Windows was cross-compiled only. UI interactions were exercised in jsdom; native Chromium was unable to launch in this runtime.
